title: What Scripture Actually Says About Your Nicotine Habit (It's Not Harmless)
caption:
You hit it at your desk, in the car, before you walk into a hard conversation. Forty times a day, and you still call it harmless.

Scripture never mentions nicotine. It talks a lot about what's allowed to own you.

“All things are lawful for me, but I will not be dominated by anything.” 1 Corinthians 6:12

Your body was bought with a price. Every craving is a chance to run to God instead of a pod.

Pick a quit date this week. Tell one brother. Have him call you on day three.

Save this for the day you throw the pods out.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #selfcontrol #scripture
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
